system.description: For some reason you refuse to hunt a certain class of prey: children, clergy, police or the like. If you accidentally feed on your excluded type, you immediately frenzy and must win a four-Trait Conscience/Conviction Challenge or lose a Morality Trait. If you merely witness someone else feeding on your excluded type, you must make a Self-Control/Instinct Virtue Test as if provoked. Ventrue may not take this Flaw.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
